title: Blacklist Cards
description: Tests models on extracting company, location, identification number, stamped date and the blacklist entries from mostly typewritten index cards of the Swiss Federal Archives on Swiss firms and individuals put on the British trade blacklist in 1940–1946.

versions.summary: ground truth corrected: the Montaner card has no stamped date (was the typed removal date 1945-06-18) and its address is no longer a text block; two cards with no text blocks record `information` as `null` (was an empty string); an empty `information` list counts as empty; a response that cannot be parsed is scored as a miss; all stored runs re-scored
